rationale: Record that a Windows test-portability fix crosses two families only through their broad test/** selectors. test/test_cli_import.cpp, test/test_gpu_diagnostics.cpp, test/test_skia_surface.cpp and test/test_view_bridge.cpp called POSIX setenv/unsetenv, which MSVC's runtime lacks, so they did not compile on Windows; they now call a new test/support/portable_env.hpp that wraps _putenv_s on Windows and setenv/unsetenv elsewhere. Each test sets and clears the same variables to the same values as before. No importer, DesignIR, capture path, renderer, asset, codegen output, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest about a change that crossed their selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
